summary: A mixed legal and business day led by judicial rulings on professional conduct, retail investment moves, and Reliance's capital market activity. Karnataka HC sanctions drunk advocate; Allahabad HC warns on Goondas Act damages; Flipkart creates 2.5L jobs; Reliance eyeing bond issuance.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court sentences advocate to one-day imprisonment for appearing drunk before judge.
Allahabad High Court warns bureaucrats must pay damages for illegal orders under Goondas Act.
Flipkart creates 2.5 lakh seasonal jobs across 7,000 Ekart facilities ahead of festive season.
Hindustan Coca-Cola invests Rs 1,127 crore in Andhra Pradesh for new beverage production unit.
Reliance Industries set to sell 5-year bonds next week via investment bankers.
